name: PR loop
description: Runs a PR through fresh independent reviews, fixes, CI and one merge-commit merge, stopping for the user when stuck

commands.name: pr-loop
commands.description: PR 自動循環：獨立 review → 修正 → CI → 合併（status / stop / resume / config）
commands.hint: <PR 編號或網址> [需求原文] | status | stop | resume | config
